subject: Calculation for the variances of intercept, slope, and residuals at each time point in LGM

messages.author: d50840982f1dfd1b
messages.subject: Calculation for the variances of intercept, slope, and residuals at each time point in LGM
parts:
Hi, all.

I am calculating 1) the variances of (latent) intercept and slope and; 2) the residual variances of indicators at each time point in LGM by hand.

But, my calculations were different from the lavaan output.

Below is the code (4 repeated measures Y0 Y1 Y2 Y3).

######## Code
MYDATA <- read.csv("C:/Users/junye/Desktop/LGM_Test/LGM_residual_calculation.csv", header = TRUE)

MODEL <- "int =~ 1*Y0 + 1*Y1 + 1*Y2 + 1*Y3
slo =~ 0*Y0 + 1*Y1 + 2*Y2 + 3*Y3
int ~~ slo"
fit <- growth(MODEL, data = MYDATA)
summary(fit)

######## Result
Intercepts:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)
   .Y0                0.000                          
   .Y1                0.000                          
   .Y2                0.000                          
   .Y3                0.000                          
    int               0.617    0.072    8.583    0.000
    slo               0.958    0.035   27.233    0.000
Variances:
                   Estimate  Std.Err  z-value  P(>|z|)
   .Y0                2.146    0.222    9.672    0.000
   .Y1                2.135    0.164   13.009    0.000
   .Y2                2.000    0.170   11.736    0.000
   .Y3                2.011    0.257    7.821    0.000
    int               1.090    0.200    5.460    0.000
    slo               0.203    0.052    3.936    0.000
########

1. I saved the factor scores for intercept and slope for all individuals like below and calculate the variances of intercept and slope.

######## Code
factor_scores <- predict(fit)
factor_scores <- as.data.frame(factor_scores)
var(factor_scores)

######## Result
          int       slo
int 0.6708315 0.1859234
slo 0.1859234 0.1027686
########

The variances of the intercept factor scores and slope factor scores were 0.671 and 0.103, respectively. However, in the summary result, the variances of the intercept and slope were 1.090 and 0.203, respectively. I thought they would be the same but it wasn't.
(+ but the mean of the intercept (0.617) and slope (0.958) based on the factor scores were the exactly same as the summary result.

Also, I calculated residuals at each time point across all individuals based on the factor scores by subtracting the predicted values from the observed values.
Then, I calculated the variances of residuals for each time point, but they were different from the summary result as well.

How can I calculate the variances of the intercept, slope, and residuals at each time point by using factor scores?
I think there would be extra steps for calculating the variances of the intercept, slope, and residuals at each time point.
Have any ideas or recommended readings?

Thank you!
